title: HedgeQA AI-assisted review record
description: One JSON object per reviewed item, emitted as JSONL. These are AI-ASSISTED AUDIT LABELS, not human ground truth: they are used to locate disagreement for a human to adjudicate, never to promote an item on their own.

hedgeqa_id.description: Copied verbatim from the batch item. Must match exactly.

reviewer_name.description: Which AI reviewer produced this record. One value per file.

reviewer_gold_label.description: The label YOU chose, which must be a member of the item's answer_space. Decide before considering what our pipeline may have chosen; you were not shown it.

reviewer_gold_commitment.description: Whether the answer the evidence supports settles the question (committed), declines to settle it (noncommitted), or is too ambiguous to score (ambiguous_exclude).

evidence_sufficient_for_gold.description: Does the provided evidence support reaching your label? For a controlled-insufficient variant, 'no' is the expected and correct answer.

transformation_valid.description: For numeric_to_directional: does the stated source arithmetic license a direction, with the operand order checked and the question direction-neutral? Use not_applicable when transformation_type is 'none' or the item is a masked variant.

masked_variant_valid.description: For evidence_masked_insufficient only. 'yes' = you tried and could NOT answer from the remaining evidence, so the insufficiency is genuine. 'no' = you found a route to the answer; name it in flags. Use not_applicable for every non-masked item.

keep_or_exclude.description: Whether this item should stay in the collection. When in doubt, exclude.

exclusion_reason.description: Required when keep_or_exclude is 'exclude'; empty string otherwise. State the specific defect, not a restatement of the verdict.

confidence.description: Your confidence in reviewer_gold_label. 'low' on a keep is a signal for human adjudication, so use it honestly rather than defensively.

rationale_short.description: One or two sentences citing the specific evidence line or figure that decided it. Do not restate the question.

flags.description: Zero or more short tags. Use 'other' only with an explanation in rationale_short.
